summary: Hagerty voted against three resolutions that would have blocked weapons sales to Israel during the Gaza war and co-introduced the UNRWA Reform Act to condition U.S. funding on anti-terrorism certification. He backed the 2023 IHRA resolution framing delegitimization of Israel as antisemitism, and in 2026 praised the Abraham Accords expansion while calling for Hamas surrender. AIPAC PAC endorsed his 2026 re-election citing his pro-Israel votes; Vote for Peace rated him Opposed.
